notes: 0.3.58：正式新版本号，收录 0.3.56 修订的全部改动。①仓库与插件统一改名为 dsh-config-sync-plugin（GitHub 仓库、README 标题、market-index、自检脚本、自引用 URL 全部对齐）；②apply.ps1 会话 projcache 工作区映射改为按 sessions 目录反推（覆盖 15→46），无 Node 执行器时跳过会话还原加保护；③apply.ps1 本地插件映射 dsh-purge 版本对齐 1.4.0；④发布产物 releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.58.tgz。运行时兼容项不变：本机设置文件仍是 ~\.dsh\dsh-config-sync.json，备份目录仍按 dsh-config-sync 前缀识别。面板交互不变。
notesEn: 0.3.58: a proper new version bundling all the 0.3.56-revision fixes. (1) Repo and plugin renamed to dsh-config-sync-plugin (GitHub repo, README titles, market-index, self-tests and self-referencing URLs all aligned); (2) apply.ps1 session projcache workspace mapping now also infers from sessions folders (coverage 15 to 46), with a guard on the no-Node skip-restore branch; (3) apply.ps1 local-plugin map aligned dsh-purge to 1.4.0; (4) artifact releases\dsh-config-sync-plugin-0.3.58.tgz. Runtime compatibility unchanged: local settings file is still ~\.dsh\dsh-config-sync.json and backup detection still matches the dsh-config-sync prefix. Panel behaviour unchanged.
